--- title: page.js description: API reference for the page.js file. --- The `page` file allows you to define UI that is **unique** to a route. You can create a page by default exporting a component from the file: ```tsx filename="app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx" switcher export default function Page({ params, searchParams, }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> searchParams: Promise<{ [key: string]: string | string[] | undefined }> }) { return

My Page

} ``` ```jsx filename="app/blog/[slug]/page.js" switcher export default function Page({ params, searchParams }) { return

My Page

} ``` ## Good to know - The `.js`, `.jsx`, or `.tsx` file extensions can be used for `page`. - A `page` is always the **leaf** of the route subtree. - A `page` file is required to make a route segment **publicly accessible**. - Pages are [Server Components](https://react.dev/reference/rsc/server-components) by default, but can be set to a [Client Component](https://react.dev/reference/rsc/use-client). - In the [component hierarchy](/docs/app/getting-started/project-structure#component-hierarchy), `page.js` is the innermost file convention. Migration is complete. The `pages` directory has been removed and the app builds successfully on the App Router.

## Migration Summary

### Layout & global setup
- **`pages/_app.js` + `pages/_document.js`** → **`app/layout.tsx`** — root layout with `AppProvider`, header/footer nav, global CSS, and `metadata`
- **`components/AppProvider.js`** → **`components/AppProvider.tsx`** — typed React context

### Pages
| Pages Router | App Router | Pattern |
|---|---|---|
| `pages/index.js` (`getServerSideProps`) | `app/page.tsx` | Server Component with `headers()` for request-time data |
| `pages/blog/index.js` (`getStaticProps`, ISR 60s) | `app/blog/page.tsx` | `export const revalidate = 60` |
| `pages/blog/[id].js` (`getStaticPaths` + ISR) | `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` | `generateStaticParams`, `dynamicParams`, `revalidate = 300`, `notFound()` |
| `pages/404.js` | `app/not-found.tsx` | `metadata` export |
| `pages/_error.js` | `app/error.tsx` | Client error boundary with `retry()` |

### API routes
| Pages Router | App Router |
|---|---|
| `pages/api/posts/index.js` | `app/api/posts/route.ts` — `GET` / `POST` handlers |
| `pages/api/posts/[id].js` | `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` — `GET` / `PUT` / `DELETE` handlers |

### API replacements
- `next/head` → `metadata` / `generateMetadata`
- `next/router` → `next/navigation` (`useRouter`) in client components
- `getServerSideProps` → async Server Component + `headers()`
- `getStaticProps` / `getStaticPaths` → `generateStaticParams` + `revalidate`
- Pages API handlers → Route Handlers with `NextResponse.json()`

### Types added
- **`types/blog.ts`** — `Post`, `Comment`
- **`types/api.ts`** — `LocalPost`, request/response types for API routes
- **`PageProps<'/blog/[id]'>`** — generated route props helper for the dynamic blog page

Client-only interactivity (navigation buttons) lives in small `'use client'` components: `ViewAllPostsButton`, `BlogPostCard`, `BlogBackButton`, and `GoHomeButton`.
